bio: Why not spoil yourself to a delicious Afternoon Tea at the Bournemouth West Cliff Hotel. Enjoy a range of sumptuous treats at this charming Hotel.  Afternoon Tea is served in the Lounge, which provides guests with a welcoming environment to enjoy a range of sweet and savoury items in friendly surroundings.  The West Cliff Hotel is set in the heart of this vibrant seaside town, just a short distance from Bournemouth town centre.
